smoothing-fw.rule: flat median over prescribed normalized final losses; any invalid/missing run disqualifies candidate; exact-score ties use lexicographic candidate ID

full-kl.rule: flat median over prescribed normalized final losses; any invalid/missing run disqualifies candidate; exact-score ties use lexicographic candidate ID

stochastic-kl.rule: flat median over prescribed normalized final losses; any invalid/missing run disqualifies candidate; exact-score ties use lexicographic candidate ID

fw.rule: flat median over prescribed normalized final losses; any invalid/missing run disqualifies candidate; exact-score ties use lexicographic candidate ID

selection_source: tuning phase only; actual final rounded plans evaluated in float64
warnings_policy: completed_with_inner_failures and completed_with_warnings remain eligible when the final plan is valid
no_valid_setting_policy: blocked dependent work; no fallback candidate
